node.statement: Validated node 1.2.3.1 gives, for every n, that v_n is bijective and ||v_n^(-1)|| <= (1-C_V*eta)^(-1), with 1-C_V*eta>0. Validated node 1.2.2.1 gives ||tilde-Phi||_cb <= 1+C_theta*eta, hence ||tilde-Phi_n|| <= 1+C_theta*eta for every n. Since tilde-Upsilon=v^(-1) composed with tilde-Phi and tilde-Phi_n has range in M_n(A), amplification commutes with composition, so tilde-Upsilon_n=v_n^(-1) composed with tilde-Phi_n. Therefore submultiplicativity gives ||tilde-Upsilon_n|| <= ||v_n^(-1)|| ||tilde-Phi_n|| <= (1+C_theta*eta)/(1-C_V*eta) for every n. Taking the supremum over n yields ||tilde-Upsilon||_cb <= (1+C_theta*eta)/(1-C_V*eta).
